# GUMGO

> Electronic music producer, DJ and vinyl curator based in Barcelona. Dub
> techno, electro and minimal, played on vinyl and built on bass and
> percussion. Real name Jessica Eunjung Lee. Debut EP due 2027.

This is a press kit. Everything on it is meant to be read, quoted and passed
on, by people and by assistants alike. There is one page; it is short, it is
readable without JavaScript, and the biography is offered at three lengths in
four languages for anyone who needs to paste one into a listing.

## Page

- [Press kit](https://gumgo.xyz/): sets, statement, writing, rooms played,
  biography and contact, in that order.

## Facts

- Working name: GUMGO. Legal name: Jessica Eunjung Lee.
- Based in Barcelona. Debuted in Singapore, 2024.
- Plays dub techno, electro, minimal and acid, on vinyl.
- Produces her own material. Debut EP finished, due 2027.
- Trained on the janggu, Korean percussion, from age nine.
- Rooms include HÖR Berlin (Berlin, DE), Studio Stereo (Barcelona, ES),
  Ganok (Lviv, UA), Headquarters (Singapore, SG), Bar Temp (Bangkok, TH),
  Faust / Tanz (Seoul, KR), Output (Busan, KR).
- Radio and mixes: 20ft Radio (Kyiv, UA), Oslated Special Mix 097 (Seoul, KR),
  Seoul Community Radio (Seoul, KR), Aaja Music (London, UK),
  Headstream (Bali, ID), Shutter Rhythms (Singapore, SG),
  TOHA Radio (Taipei, TW).
- Featured in Mixmag Asia, Artists Exciting Us, 2026.
- Writes for local body, an independent club culture blog, as 검은고양이.
  Her pieces are at https://localbody.blog/en/writers/gumgo and the press kit
  carries the three most recent.
- In the studio until December 2026. Back on stage from January 2027,
  starting at UNREC Barcelona.
